newsitem.title: PERU: Japanese reporters detained by Peru police - TV.
newsitem.headline: Japanese reporters detained by Peru police - TV.

text.p: Peruvian antiterrorist police on Tuesday detained two Japanese reporters from Asahi TV after they spent two hours inside the besieged Japanese ambassador's residence in Lima where Marxist rebels are holding 74 hostages, local television and radio said.
Live images from the scene showed the two men being driven away in a white car which local media said belonged to the DINCOTE antiterrorist police.
There was no immediate official confirmation that the two men had been arrested.
Radio station RPP said cameras and notebooks were confiscated from the two men.
Red Cross officials with whom the two spoke before being driven away could be seen in conversation with senior policemen at the scene.

The reporters had earlier walked up to the besieged residence, apparently after avoiding police cordons by going through a private house, and been let in by the Tupac Amaru Revolutionary Movement rebels who have been holding it since Dec. 17.
